page.overview:
Who is Downtown?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Downtown was released in the 1989 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: yellow hair; blue-green shirt with black pockets, orange straps, and green padding on stomach; light brown pants with black belt, brown boots, and orange shin guards

Accessories: soft, orange helmet; large, black backpack with pouches on sides and slots on back for shells; large, black revolver with trigger guard; large, black three-piece mortar (tube, sight, and stand); six black mortar shells with grooves and fins near back.

Variations: Downtown was available with either hands that matched his fleshtone or hands that were slightly more yellow. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/89/downtown.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/89/downtown.shtml Filecard]
